description: One sector ETF in depth: its quadrant, momentum and returns vs SPY, valuation, and its largest holdings (up to 25). For each holding: weight, quadrant against the sector ETF (not against SPY), momentum, 1-month change and the gap to the sector. The 11 broad S&P 500 sectors (XLK, XLF, XLV, XLE, XLI, XLY, XLP, XLU, XLB, XLRE, XLC) are free; every other sector needs Premium. Get symbols from zensei_sectors_scan.
